topic.guidance:
Prioritize AI models, tools, agents, research and launches useful to builders.
Exclude: Promotional content and SEO filler
Required phrases: AI, artificial intelligence, machine learning, LLM, OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepMind, software, programming, developer, code, coding, computer, computing, technology, tech, chip, semiconductor, GPU, Apple, Microsoft, Google, Meta, Linux, browser, internet, cybersecurity, robot, robotics, design, startup, smartphone, iPhone, Android, database, JavaScript, Python, Rust
Excluded phrases: sponsored, promo code, gift guide, best deals

brief: Apple HomeView 27.2 code reportedly contains hints of security camera features for the smart home hub.
Anthropic is expanding text watermarking to older Claude versions beginning November 3.
Brazilian lawyers were fined $16,000 after hidden prompt-injection text in a filing targeted a court's AI.
A Hacker News item claims a team of five Qwen3.8-27B models beats Fable 5 on LiveCodeBench Hard.

stories.headline: Apple HomeView code hints at security camera features for smart home hub
stories.summary: According to The Verge, a Reddit user named pdfu found hints in HomeView 27.2 code that Apple could be adding security camera features to its smart home hub. The strings reportedly describe a security camera mode with motion detection, live streaming, recording options and privacy functions.
stories.whyItMatters: If the hints reflect a shipping feature, the smart home hub would gain home-security capabilities.
stories.rationale: Concrete product-direction evidence for Apple platform builders and smart home developers.

stories.headline: Anthropic expands text watermarking to older Claude versions from November 3
stories.summary: Mashable reports that Anthropic is expanding text watermarking to older Claude versions beginning November 3.
stories.whyItMatters: Extends watermarking coverage across more Claude model versions, which affects developers building on those models.
stories.rationale: Clear AI tooling change affecting Claude users and builders.

stories.headline: Brazilian lawyers fined $16,000 over prompt injection aimed at court's AI
stories.summary: Tom's Hardware reports that a court's AI flagged hidden text in a filing that demanded superficial legal scrutiny. The lawyers were fined $16,000.
stories.whyItMatters: Illustrates prompt injection targeting AI tools that screen legal filings.
stories.rationale: Concrete security incident relevant to developers deploying LLM-based document review.

stories.headline: Team of five Qwen3.8-27B models claims lead over Fable 5 on LiveCodeBench Hard
stories.summary: A Hacker News item titled "Memdoor: A team of 5 Qwen3.8-27B models beats Fable 5 on LiveCodeBench Hard" reports that a multi-model team outperforms Fable 5 on this coding benchmark.
stories.whyItMatters: Points to multi-model systems as a route to stronger results on a difficult coding benchmark.
stories.rationale: Relevant to programming and developer audiences tracking coding benchmark results.

stories.headline: Hospital outside US says it receives latest OpenAI capabilities first
stories.summary: In a quoted statement reported by Calcalist Tech, a hospital said: "We're the first hospital outside the US that gets the latest capabilities of OpenAI."
stories.whyItMatters: Shows healthcare providers adopting frontier AI tools early.
stories.rationale: Relevant OpenAI adoption story for AI builders and health-tech observers.
